bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 1
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Delivery, CCA273, confirm frequency for airport service, we need re-catering.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA273, Delivery, contact Apron on 119.25.

questions.question: What service does CCA273 need?
questions.explanation: 飞行员明确说明 "we need re-catering"，即需要重新配餐（餐饮服务），对应选项 Food delivery；refueling（加油）、medical（医疗）、mechanical service（机务）均未提及，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: N204DT, Wuhan GND, you are on the wrong taxiway, continue taxi and via R5, C8, K to holding point of RWY05L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue taxi, via R5, C8 and K to holding point, RWY05L, N204DT.

questions.question: How should N204DT taxi?

options.A: R5, C8, K to holding point, RWY05R
options.B: R8, C5, K to holding point, RWY05R
options.C: R8, K5, C to holding point, RWY05L
options.D: R5, C8, K to holding point, RWY05L

questions.explanation: 管制员指令 "via R5, C8, K to holding point of RWY05L"，飞行员也完整复诵了该滑行路线和 05L 跑道等待点，只有 D 与之完全一致；其余选项在滑行道编号或跑道号（05R）上有误，故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, control, DLH975, we have a passenger had a stroke, we've managed to stabilize his condition, but we need to divert immediately.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: DLH975, control, roger PANPAN, say your intentions.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Request divert to Wuhan, DLH975.

questions.question: Why is DLH975 making an urgency call?

options.C: Because a passenger had a stroke.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发布 PANPAN 时说明 "we have a passenger had a stroke"，即机上有乘客中风，需要立即备降，故选 C；B 的 stabilized 只是已稳住病情，并非发布紧急呼叫的原因。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: NWA441, Wuhan app, radar contact, follow XSH-02 Arrival, expect ILS approach, RWY36R, descent to 3600m, Info U.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, XSH-01 Arrival, ILS approach, say again after RWY36R, NWA441.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: NWA441, XSH-02 Arrival, descend to 3600m, Info U.

questions.question: What mistake did the pilot make during the readback?

options.A: The pilot was wrong about the altitude and Info.
options.B: The pilot was wrong about the callsign and missed altitude and Arrival procedure.
options.C: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed Info.
options.D: The pilot was wrong about the Arrival procedure and missed altitude and Info.

questions.explanation: 管制员指令为 "XSH-02 Arrival"，飞行员却复诵成 "XSH-01 Arrival"，进场程序复诵错误；同时漏掉了 "descend to 3600m" 和 "Info U"，管制员随后专门补报了这两项，故选 D。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, CES8801, we have traffic indication at 1 o'clock, 12nm, 600m below us, it's climbing rapidly, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES8801, it's a military aircraft, reduce speed to 270 knots, maintain 8900m.

questions.question: Where is the military aircraft?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告冲突航空器位于 "1 o'clock, 12nm, 600m below us, it's climbing rapidly"，与 A 完全一致；B 的方位和高度、C 的 above、D 的 descending 均与原文不符，故选 A。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, JAL406, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL406, cleared for takeoff, RWY18, surface wind calm, after airborne, contact Departure on 124.75.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Dep 124.75, JAL406.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, JAL406, 300m climbing. We had a bird strike and the co-pilot is injured, request return to land.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL406, roger, continue runway heading, turn right after 900m, do you need any assistance?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue runway heading, turn right after 900m, request a doctor upon landing, JAL406.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Roger, JAL406, doctor will be ready for you. Contact Approach 127.35.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 127.35, thanks, JAL406.

questions.question: What is the wind condition when JAL406 takes off?
questions.explanation: 塔台发布起飞许可时明确说 "surface wind calm"，calm 即静风、无风，故选 D。

questions.question: What happened to JAL406 during takeoff?
questions.explanation: 飞行员爬升至 300 米时报告 "We had a bird strike and the co-pilot is injured"，即遭遇鸟击，故选 C；对话未提及鸟被吸入发动机（bird ingestion），副驾驶受伤不等于飞行员失能。

questions.question: Which frequency should JAL406 call finally?
questions.explanation: 对话最后管制员指令 "Contact Approach 127.35"，飞行员复诵 "Approach, 127.35"，这是最终要联系的频率；124.75 是起飞前提到的离场频率，故选 B。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW533, Wuhan control, due traffic, offset 4nm left of track, expect rejoin the route at ZF.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 4nm left of track, BAW533.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, BAW 533, we have weather indication 25nm ahead of us, request deviate to the left for 11nm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW 533, negative due to prohibited area, can you accept deviation to the right?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 150 for 18nm, BAW533.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW 533, turn right heading 150, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Right heading 150, wilco, BAW533.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan control, BAW533, we encountered lightning strike, and starboard engine is leaking fuel. We are emergency descending to 3600m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW533, Wuhan control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan control, emergency descent between DA and TM, all aircraft below 8200m, leave the route to the west.

questions.question: How can BAW533 avoid the weather according to the pilot?

options.A: Deviate to the left side for 11nm.
options.C: Deviate to the right side for 18nm.
options.D: Deviate to the left side for 25nm.

questions.explanation: 飞行员自己提出的绕飞方案是 "request deviate to the left for 11nm"，即向左偏 11 海里，故选 A；25nm 是天气距离，heading 150 for 18nm 是后来向右绕飞的方案，均不符题意。

questions.question: Why can't BAW533 detour the weather from the left side?

options.A: Because there is a restricted area.
options.B: Because there is a lightning strike.
options.C: Because there is a prohibited area.

questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝左侧绕飞时明确说明 "negative due to prohibited area"，即因禁区不能向左绕飞，故选 C；restricted area（限制区）与 prohibited area（禁区）含义不同，属于干扰项。

questions.question: What happened to BAW 533?

options.A: BAW533 encountered fuel leakage due to lightning strike.
options.B: BAW533 encountered lightning strike and engine fire.

questions.explanation: MAYDAY 呼叫中飞行员说 "we encountered lightning strike, and starboard engine is leaking fuel"，即遭雷击且右发漏油，与 A 相符；对话未提及发动机起火或左发故障，紧急下降是应对措施而非遭遇的事件本身，故选 A。

questions.question: Where is BAW 533 when he started emergency descent?

options.B: West of DA and TM at 3600m.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 "emergency descending to 3600m"，管制员随后广播 "emergency descent between DA and TM"，说明紧急下降发生在 DA 与 TM 之间、目标高度 3600 米，故选 C。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CSN803, 12nm final, established ILS, RWY36.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN803, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 150kts, report outer marker.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 150kts, report outer marker, CSN803.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN803, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36, wind 030, 7m/s, gusting up to 16m/s. QNH1032.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36, QNH1032, thanks, CSN803.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN803, we had a tail strike during landing due to unstable wind, APU and main gear damaged. Unable to vacate runway, Request a tug to tow us back.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN803, roger, tug is on the way. Break Break. AFR123, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied due to aircraft unable to vacate.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, AFR123.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, AFR123, we have 2 passengers injured during the missed approach, request an ambulance upon arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR123, roger, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.85.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, 124.85, AFR123.

questions.question: Why did CSN803 encounter a tail strike?

options.C: The speed of the aircraft was too slow.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "we had a tail strike during landing due to unstable wind"，明确指出擦机尾的原因是风不稳定，故选 A；阵风、速度慢、APU 故障均不是飞行员所述原因。

questions.question: What was the consequences of CSN 803's tail strike?

options.B: APU and main gear damage, unable to taxi.
options.D: Main gear damage and APU failure.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告擦机尾导致 "APU and main gear damaged. Unable to vacate runway"，即 APU 与主起落架受损、无法自行滑离跑道（需拖车拖回），与 B 相符；对话未提及起火，D 漏掉了无法滑行的后果，故选 B。

questions.question: What was AFR123's request after the missed approach?
questions.explanation: 复飞后 AFR123 报告 "we have 2 passengers injured during the missed approach, request an ambulance upon arrival"，即因两名乘客受伤请求救护车（医疗服务），故选 B；124.85 是管制员给的频率而非 AFR123 的请求。
